# Project Lighthouse

Marker MC_P5_EN_001. New team members request repository access from the platform owner and complete security training before receiving write permission.

Marker MC_P5_EN_002. Production knowledge is backed up daily with a 24-hour recovery point objective.

# 溪流项目手册

标记 MC_P5_ZH_001。新成员必须先完成安全培训，再由平台负责人开通代码库写入权限。

标记 MC_P5_ZH_002。知识库每天备份一次，恢复点目标为二十四小时。
